note: Measured 2026-11-25 on the real apps (iPhone 13 Pro Max, iOS 27; Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn) from the accessibility frames of every button and text, converted into the 1080 x 1920 file with each app's own scaling and side crop, plus 24 px air. Where a format has a 'zone' polygon, that polygon is the usable area; the edge margins are the bounding box. Backgrounds and video may fill the canvas; text, logo and the product's key details stay inside.
